slides.label: Overview
slides.title: OCUMEDA Website
slides.lede: Proposal for the design and Framer implementation of OCUMEDA's website restyling. The new style runs through the whole website: clear and fresh, warm and human, precise without ever feeling clinical. The main pages show the product through mockups, and reusable Framer components work across every page.

items.title: The New CI
points: The new style runs through the whole website: clear and fresh, warm and human, precise without ever feeling clinical.

items.title: Warm Med-tech
points: Medical expertise with a human face: "Med-tech that radiates warmth".

items.title: A Clearer Story
points: Home, Ärzte, Optiker and Kunden show more of the actual product, with mockups instead of abstract animations.

rows.value: The new identity becomes one visual language across the whole website: clear and fresh, warm and human, precise without ever feeling clinical.
Visitors understand the product faster. Storyline, structure and information architecture give the main pages a clear, human path.
Every page feels consistent. Blue and Fog keep it clear, Amber and Soft Orange bring warmth, and the type stays precise rather than clinical.
New pages are faster to build, and the brand stays consistent on every page. Reusable Framer components carry that style through the whole website.
Visitors see the product itself. New graphics and product mockups, based on the new brand guidelines and the new photography style.
Home, Ärzte, Optiker and Kunden explain the product with clarity and trust, in a warm, human tone.
Every screen stays clear and comfortable. Breakpoints are checked so the layout holds together.
Text content is supplied by Ocumeda. Writing the copy is out of scope.
Team, Karriere, Blog and other secondary pages get no structural or content changes. Standorte stays a placeholder. The new CI still reaches them through the reusable components.
